# PROJECT_NAME

> One or two sentences that say what PROJECT_NAME is, written for a language model that
> has never seen the project.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. It is an index for language models and agents
that read the repository from outside, such as a model asked to write code against it.
Links are absolute, so the file works when fetched on its own. They name `HEAD`,
which GitHub resolves to the default branch, whatever it is called.

## Start Here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/sgeos/PROJECT_NAME/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): onboarding for any AI assistant.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/sgeos/PROJECT_NAME/blob/HEAD/CLAUDE.md): authoritative project context, conventions and per-session protocol.
- [README](https://github.com/sgeos/PROJECT_NAME/blob/HEAD/README.md): project overview and quick start.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/sgeos/PROJECT_NAME/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md): architecture, decisions, roadmap and process.
